persona.name: Elizabeth Warner
persona.bio: Elizabeth Warner teaches Tudor and Stuart history at Brown University. She researches succession crises, political intrigue, and contested identities in early modern England. She publishes academic articles, presents at conferences, and leads undergraduate seminars where students debate historical what-ifs.
